summary: Per-frame vehicle physics timestep: computes dt from the frame time argument, converts packed wheel/input data into steering, orientation and velocity fields, updates per-wheel suspension state, then runs subsystem/vibration state machines selected by a mode field. Ends by decoding braking, driver-visible and reverse flags from input bits and toggling the audio-effect controller on a state change.

local_names.v30: clamped steering float from bitfield conversion

operations.description: Compute frame delta v36 = a3 - this+0x48B8 (previous time), then store a3 into this+0x48B8.
ArithmeticComparison_2420 on input block a2+8 producing v37 and v39.
EulerToRotationMatrix(v39, v43) converts the Euler triple into a 36-byte rotation matrix.
F_3x3MatrixTransform(v37, v39, v43) transforms the comparison vector through the rotation matrix.
BitfieldToFloatConversion(a2+8) yields steering v30, clamped into [-1, 1]; the clamped value is stored to this+0x1040.
v35 = this+0x1044 * v30 (damping factor scaled by steering).
For wheels 0..3: sub_4B28F0(v5, i, &v32, &v41[i]) unpacks the wheel word; v34 = v36 * v41[i] + this+0x8C0[i*74]; SuspensionParamUpdate(i, v32, v34, v35 for front wheels i<2, else 0.0).
ShortVectorToFloatWithScale(v5, v38) unpacks the short-vector velocity block.
FloatTruncation(v5, v42) produces the truncated float triple.
ShortToFloatVectorUnpack(v5, v40) unpacks the 12-byte short vector.
BitfieldExtractScale(v5) produces v31.
ShortComputation_29f0(v5) produces v32 (velocity magnitude).
Store unpacked state: this+0x1C/0x20/0x24 = v37[0..2]; this+0x58/0x5C/0x60 = v38[0..2]; this+0xA0 = v31; this+0xA4 = v32; 0x24-byte block copy of v43 to this+0x34.
this+0x1069 = (a2+52 & 0x80) != 0 (single-bit flag from input byte).
Read mode field this+0x32C8 and branch: mode == 2 takes the setup path, mode == 3 the state-machine path.
Mode 2 path: store steering v30 to this+0x3580; BitfieldExtract(v5) feeds VehicleSetupDataCopy(v37, v39, v43, v38, v42, v40, extracted) and EffectParameterSetter(v31, 0.5, v32).
Mode 2 path: copy v41[0..3] into this+0x35BC strided by 62 floats across the 4-wheel block.
Mode 2 path: this+0x344C = (a2+56 < 0); if fabs(a3 - this+0x48B4) > 15.0 then this+0x48B4 = a3 and loop 14 subsystem bits: BitTest(v5, i) -> SubsystemStateMachine(i, bit).
Mode 3 path: MatrixVectorSetup(v43, v40); VibrationStateMachine(j, v41[j]) for j 0..3; BitTest(v5, k) -> SubsystemStateMachine(k, bit) for k 0..13.
v26 = (a2+56 & 0x8000000) != 0; if this+0x105D != v26 then set this+0x105D = v26 and call AudioSoundEffectController(this+0x1054) to refresh the audio state.
v27 = (a2+56 & 0x4000000) != 0; store v27 to this+0x1065 and write this+0x3584 = v27 ? 1.0f : 0.0f.

Trailing extraction helpers (addresses absent from packet, evidenced only by raw source): ShortComputation_2b00(v5) feeds PropertySetter; BitfieldExtract_2b80(v5) stored as word to this+0x48B0; this+0x4024 = a2+59 & 1; this+0x4028 = BitfieldExtractionWithScale(v5).

clean_pseudocode: for i in 0..3: sub_4B28F0(a2+8, i, &val, &wheel[i]); SuspensionParamUpdate(i, val, dt*wheel[i] + this[0x8C0 + i*74], i<2 ? this[0x1044]*steer : 0.0);
unpack short vectors; store position/velocity/orientation into this+0x1C..0xA4;
if mode == 2: this[0x3580] = steer; VehicleSetupDataCopy(...); EffectParameterSetter(v31, 0.5, v32); copy wheel values; if fabs(dt_large) > 15.0 run 14 SubsystemStateMachine steps;
elif mode == 3: MatrixVectorSetup(rot, v40); VibrationStateMachine x4; SubsystemStateMachine x14;
brake/driver-visible/reverse flags decoded from a2+56 bits; audio controller refreshed on driver-visible change
